messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout: service=model-service image=redwood/model:v2.3.1 -> 10% traffic (us-west-2). change-window=02:00-04:00 UTC. release-notes: https://internal.releases/redwood/model/v2.3.1 :rocket:

sam: thanks. tagging this thread for a hold/go decision if we see abnormal signals. @emily please watch errors/latency for first 15m. :eyes:

emily: tailing logs for model-worker pods in us-west-2 now. running quick grep for 5xx and oom.
```bash
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=model-worker -f | grep -E "5..|OOMKilled"
```

raj: saw a small bump in 502s at 02:02 UTC on one AZ earlier during internal smoke. recommend pause ramp if it persists.

andrew: agree with caution. hold at 10% until signals clear. will apply pin so autoscaler/rollout won't bump further.

deploy-bot: action=hold applied. traffic remains pinned to 10% for v2.3.1. no further ramps. note: rollout_id=rl-1845301234. :white_check_mark:

emily: quick summary from logs: a subset of requests hitting a specific model shard hit a KV cache regeneration path adding ~200ms; not full OOMs. 5xxs are correlated with transient redis timeouts in that AZ. posting sample error: 
```
ERROR model-worker shard=12 request_id=abc123 redis: timeout after 100ms
```

sam: thanks. so far limited to us-west-2a and ~0.6% error rate overall. threshold for rollback is 1.5% sustained for 5m. propose we keep pinned at 10% and run traces + slowpath fix deploy to canary infra.

li: starting distributed traces and opening eval subset. adding synthetic traffic against v2.3.1 on us-west-2a to reproduce.

raj: ops ask: should we rollback immediately for customer-facing routes? my vote: no rollback yet, keep hold, escalate redis ops to investigate failovers. if errors spike above threshold, auto-rollback plan is ready.

oncall-bot: alert created: INC-2026-045, pager duty engaged for redis-cluster-usw2.

andrew: decision: HOLD->KEEP at 10% for 30m to collect traces and metrics. if error_rate > 1.5% for 5m OR latency p95 increases > 300ms, then ROLLBACK to v2.3.0. tagging @oncall. :hammer_and_wrench:

sam: adding release-note annotation: "pinned at 10% due to transient redis timeouts in us-west-2; monitoring". will notify SRE/CS if we hit rollback.

emily: creating a small config diff for a quick retry/backoff to push to canary infra (not prod) to validate fix path.

li: traces collecting, ETA 20m to have a clear picture.

andrew: leaving this thread open. deploy-bot will post ramp/resume or rollback commands. please ack by reacting with :thumbsup: when you see metrics at steady state.

deploy-bot: next-automated-check scheduled at ts=1845301494. will report metrics snapshot then.
